description:
The US Air Force is looking for vendors capable of providing mobile laundry services for members supporting recovery on Tinian. The attached Statement of Objectives (SOO) provides details regarding what is desired. If your company is unable to meet the performance objectives, but you think you could provide an alternative solution, please submit your solution. Our basic requirement is at least 3 washers and dryers that meet our objectives.

If you have questions or concerns, please reach out to us.
